states: 2026-10-26: each Bip's state computed for Pocket TTS 4.0.1 from its own <voice>_source.wav (a Dutch clip, see source) with the cloning model kyutai/pocket-tts (CC-BY-4.0), dutch weights, get_state_for_audio_prompt(truncate=True) then export_model_state; <voice>_sample.wav spoken with it (torch seed 42); Whisper large-v3-turbo forced to Dutch hears every source clip and sample right (wer below).

source.model: Chatterbox Multilingual (ResembleAI/chatterbox, MIT, https://github.com/resemble-ai/chatterbox), the chatterbox-tts package from PyPI
source.text: Goedemorgen! Ik heb even naar je dag gekeken: drie afspraken, en vanmiddag nog wat tijd voor een wandeling. Zal ik je een kwartier van tevoren herinneren?
source.note: 2026-10-26: Qwen3-TTS has no Dutch: Chatterbox spoke the sentence in each Bip's English timbre with accent transfer off (cfg_weight 0), option (c) of the Dutch listening bench, chosen by ear. The take's silences trimmed (0.1 s kept) and, at 10 s or more, cut in its last pause before 10 s (Pocket's dutch model, like german and spanish, reads short with a long reference). The clips carry Resemble AI's imperceptible Perth watermark; the Bips' speech is Pocket's.
source.check: Whisper mlx-community/whisper-large-v3-turbo, language nl, temperature 0: word error rate against the sentence (or, for a cut take, its spoken part), punctuation and case ignored; 5 % at most, else another seed
